input: Write a Python function that returns the first duplicate value in a list, or None when all values are unique.
rationale: A set records values already encountered. Scan from left to right so the first value already in the set is the first duplicate. Set membership is expected O(1), giving O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space.

input: Explain how to determine whether a binary tree is height-balanced.
rationale: Use post-order traversal because a parent height depends on both children. Return a sentinel when a subtree is already unbalanced, which avoids recomputing heights. A node is balanced exactly when its child heights differ by at most one.
